item.title: New AI Engineer Positions Target Automation in Finance and Manufacturing
item.description:
New AI Engineer Positions Target Automation in Finance and Manufacturing

Several organizations have announced new AI engineering positions focused on automation and integration with Microsoft Copilot and Azure AI, reflecting growing demand for AI‑driven solutions in financial services and manufacturing.

🔍 Overview

  • Companies are hiring AI engineers to design smart solutions, streamline processes, and help shape the future of how business gets done.

🛠️ Roles & Focus

Role Focus Location
AI Engineer (Automation) Payments engineering (financial services) Sandton
Junior Automation Engineer Access automation & security solutions (manufacturing)
AI Engineer - Microsoft Copilot & Azure AI (unspecified)

🏢 Companies hiring

  • Psybergate – An IT company that builds bespoke software solutions and provides highly skilled resources to its clients.
  • A leading organisation within the financial services sector – seeking an experienced AI engineer (Automation) for a next‑generation Payments engineering team.
  • A premier South African manufacturer specialising in world‑class access automation and security solutions – seeking a Junior Automation engineer for its R&D team.

💡 Why it matters

  • The roles emphasize “design smart solutions, streamline processes, and help shape the future of how business gets done,” highlighting the strategic importance of AI‑powered automation across industries.
